history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.description: In the breeders-x4 and breeders-x8 worlds on borg-reborn-rs track-p 353f5c09 (hold 128 and osc 3 shipped, #1124), do the shipped retreat guards matter among white worm masses, and do back-aways counted in the run (#1023's Priest 1512540769 loop) or the poisoned escape (#934) change the breeder games? experiment.name: reborn-guards-breeders-pilot
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-23: borg-reborn-rs owner, "can we make a bigger experiment" and "and also in the breeder world... but use the latest build" (borg-zoo#742).
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-23, before any game of this build was played in these worlds (borg-zoo#742; RULES 21). Five arms (ctl = shipped; guardsoff = hold and osc 0;
ba = back-aways counted; poison = 75; plus = ba, reach 1, kill 3, poison 75) in breeders-x8 and breeders-x4 (10 profiles), classes-18, 18 starts each
(180 cells), 100,000 turns, evidence retained. A world's arms are compared only within that world. Gate: no config_error; one binary; every cell
records its world with the same borg_world_data_sha256 in every arm of that world; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death,
turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls apart; identical plays. Report per world, arm and class: deaths and causes (breeders and poison apart), CL and DL,
paired rescued and newly killed against the world's ctl; per arm the counts of "# No retreat: N moves away in a row", "# Stair flight avoiding
retreat grid", "# Poisoned, no cure" and back-ups next to a breeder. A world is a stress test: a lead here needs the normal-world tiers. Directional
(RULES 14).
